subject: Electrical Engineering
title: NAND and NOR: Universal Gates
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: NAND and NOR: Universal Gates.

hook.text: A NAND gate is an AND followed by a NOT. It's simple — and it can do everything.

buildup.text: NAND outputs 0 only when both inputs are 1. Any other combination gives 1.

discovery.text: You can build AND, OR, NOT, and any logic function using only NAND gates.

twist.text: NOR gates are also universal. Early Apollo guidance computers were built entirely from NOR gates.

climax.text: Chip designers often use NAND-only or NOR-only libraries to simplify manufacturing.

punchline.text: One gate type to rule them all — NAND is the universal building block.

quiz.question: What makes NAND a 'universal' gate?
options: It is the fastest gate to manufacture
Any logic function can be built using only NAND gates
It uses the least power of any gate type
